title: Frank Moore receives letters concerning UFO incidents
alt: Archival photograph of two men at a table with large stacks of letters; one man points toward the mail.
caption: The Jimmy Carter Library and National Archives catalog this White House photograph as Frank Moore receiving 9,000 letters about UFO incidents in connection with a National Enquirer article. The image documents a reported volume of public correspondence; it does not show what individual letters said.
credit: White House Staff Photographers, 26 April 1978. National Archives and Records Administration via DPLA and Wikimedia Commons.
rights: Commons record states “No Copyright — United States”; verify the source page for jurisdictional notes and other rights.
